facts.claim: Median growth for companies between 1 million and 30 million dollars ARR is 26%, with top performers at 40% to 50%
facts.source_title: Rule of 40 in SaaS: 2026 Data, Benchmarks and Valuation Impact
facts.excerpt: For companies in the $1M-$30M ARR range, median growth is 26%, while top performers grow at 40-50%.

facts.claim: Bootstrapped SaaS companies between 3 million and 20 million dollars ARR grow at a 15% median
facts.excerpt: SaaS Capital's 2026 private B2B SaaS benchmark shows median revenue growth of 15% for bootstrapped SaaS companies with $3m to $20m ARR.

facts.claim: The median Rule of 40 score was 25% in 2025, and the measure only starts to bite from about 20 million dollars ARR
facts.source_title: Rule of 40 in SaaS: 2026 Data, Benchmarks and Valuation Impact
facts.excerpt: The 2025 median Rule of 40 score is 25%. The Rule of 40 becomes a meaningful benchmark at roughly $20M ARR and above.

facts.claim: Median private B2B SaaS gross revenue retention fell to 84% in 2025 while annual net revenue retention compressed to 101%
facts.excerpt: The median SaaS gross revenue retention rate fell to 84% in 2025; annual NRR compressed to 101% across all private B2B SaaS.

facts.claim: Net revenue retention splits hard by contract size: 97% under 25,000 dollars ACV, about 108% from 25,000 to 100,000, and 118% above that
facts.excerpt: Enterprise (over $100K ACV) at a median 118% NRR, mid-market ($25K-$100K ACV) at about 108%, and SMB (under $25K ACV) at 97%.

facts.claim: Median recovery of involuntary churn is 47.6%, with top performers reaching 70% to 85%
facts.excerpt: The industry median recovery rate for involuntary churn is 47.6%, with top-performer recovery reaching 70-85%.
